spike_reason: Stage-3 run completed with full ControlNet + IP-Adapter + LoRA. ControlNet successfully enforced front-facing orientation (major improvement over stage-1 multi-angle reference sheet). IP-Adapter conditioned character identity (consistent military figure type). However, cross-row equipment/costume variation remains: rows 1 and 3 are internally consistent front-facing views; row 2 shows equipment drift and some angle variation. At game scale (48x48), rows 1 and 3 could form 3-frame idle loops. Not a clean idle animation sheet. Failure mode: identity_drift (costume inconsistency across rows) vs stage-1's wrong_subject (multi-angle reference sheet). Decision: ambiguous -> default to deterministic synthesis per decision tree.
